answer: Embodied actuator footprint: each identity must control a distinct physical effector—a robot arm, valve, or vehicle—whose sensorimotor signature (backlash, thermal drift, vibration spectrum) is measured continuously. Enforcement: identity weight scales with verified signature entropy, so simulated duplicates map to one actuator. The hollow cost: renting N unique actuators for the epoch. No atlas of serial numbers suffices; forging signatures demands hardware. Attacker pays N device-hours, capping the horizon of achievable sybil weight.
